Maria V: Quick sync: PM wants Console to default NEW orgs to not send SDK routing/quota hints. Rationale: avoid accidental dedicated pool usage and surprise costs.
Kevin L: Is this privacy-related or purely cost/ops?
Tina R: Mostly cost/ops + simpler onboarding. Dedicated routes spike spend for low-volume orgs.
Josh P: SDK contract note: clients currently include an x-rd-route header by default. Changing default is a breaking behavior for customers relying on affinity.
Carla S: Suggestion: make it opt-in at SDK level for new orgs, leave existing org behavior unchanged. Expose a Console switch to flip the default for the org.
Maria V: UX idea: single org-level toggle "Prefer dedicated affinity (SDK route hint)" with inline help showing "May increase cost; improves session locality." and a link to docs.
Kevin L: How should SDKs learn the org default? embedding in tokens vs runtime config fetch?
Tina R: We have a /v1/orgs/{id}/settings endpoint. Plan: SDKs fetch on startup, cache with TTL header (cache-control max-age) and respect server TTL for fast rollouts.
Josh P: SDK change: new boolean config `sendRouteHint`. Default true for existing orgs, false for orgs created after rollout date. Also env override REDWOOD_SEND_ROUTE_HINT for ops.
Carla S: Compatibility: SDKs should keep a graceful fallback flow. Pseudocode:
```
headers = {}
if client.config.sendRouteHint and org.route_hint:
  headers['x-redwood-route-hint'] = org.route_hint
# still send request even if header absent
resp = http.post(..., headers=headers)
```
Maria V: Rollout proposal: dev + dogfood 2w, canary 5% of new orgs for 2w, monitor. Metrics: percent requests with route_hint, dedicated-host decision rate, per-org cost delta.
Kevin L: Telemetry privacy: don't log full tokens or request payloads. Send aggregated stats + a sampled boolean per request. Add events: `sdk.route_hint.sent`, `sdk.route_hint.ignored`, `sdk.route_hint.evaluated`.
Tina R: Backend tasks: add settings endpoint, TTL header, telemetry flags, and a migration API so admins can opt all their teams in/out.
Josh P: I'll draft the SDK PR: config flag, env override, changelog deprecation note, migration guide for Dedicated-only customers.
Carla S: Ops: implement server-side short grace routing for 30 days so missing hint doesn't immediately break Dedicated affinity. Also add alert if cost delta exceeds threshold.
Maria V: Action items & owners:
- Josh: SDK PR + changelog + env var docs — due Wed
- Tina: /v1/orgs settings + TTL + telemetry flags — due Thu
- Kevin: Console toggle UI + banner text + admin opt bulk action — due Fri
- Carla: graceful server fallback + alert rule — due next Tue
Maria V: I'll file the RFC tomorrow with timeline & canary success criteria. Any objections? :thumbsup:
Kevin L: No objections from me.
Josh P: SGTM.
